name: ne-memory
description: SillyTavern 长对话结构化记忆管理引擎。支持酒馆助手脚本模式 (Tavern Helper) 和酒馆原生插件模式 (Extension)。

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=all NE_BUILD=dev rollup -c
scripts.build:script: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=script NE_BUILD=dev rollup -c
scripts.build:all: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=all NE_BUILD=dev rollup -c
scripts.build:release: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=all NE_BUILD=prod rollup -c
scripts.build:release:script: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=script NE_BUILD=prod rollup -c
scripts.build:dev:all: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=all NE_BUILD=dev rollup -c
scripts.build:dev:script: node scripts/generate-test-data.cjs && cross-env BUILD_MODE=script NE_BUILD=dev rollup -c
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ratchet
